facts.headline: HeyAnon: AI-Driven DeFi Meets a 75% Drawdown
facts.summary: HeyAnon, an AI-driven DeFi protocol, pairs conversational AI with real-time data aggregation. Despite a 75% drop from its $24.73 all-time high under market pressure and meme-coin competition, its growth case rests on deeper AI utility and reaching beyond a crypto-native audience.
